text:
maria: quick ping — onboarding rumi-v2 weights at gs://rw-weights/rumi-v2/2026-03-15/sha256:abcd... noticed tokenizer seems to drop a leading sentinel when we use the chat template wrapper. expected BOS token retained but token counts are lower. anyone seen this?
sam: can you paste the exact prompt and the token counts you saw? also which tokenizer version?
maria: sure — tokenizer 0.14.2. example:
```
chat_template:
  - role: user
    content: "Hello"
  - role: assistant
    content: ""
```
raw prompt after rendering: `�<|sot|>User: Hello
Assistant:`
measured tokens: 18 (expected ~21 with BOS/EOS).
devon: hmmm, that matches a bug we saw where promptwrap/escape removes zero-width or sentinel-like tokens before tokenization. the tokenizer has a pre-tokenize step that strips characters listed in `special_strip` in tokenizer.json.
jeff: @maria can you confirm if `model_config.yaml` for this model has `promptwrap: true` or any `escape_chars` set? if so that would explain it.
maria: model_config.yaml has `promptwrap: true` and `chat_template: default`. no explicit escape_chars. i can flip promptwrap off as a temporary test.
tokenizer-bot: repro confirmed on my end. tokenizer 0.14.2 pre-tokenize rules remove the `�` prefix when promptwrap=true and chat_template present. root cause: special token mapping includes an empty-string alias for `` which collides with sentinel handling.
sam: quick mitigation: add `preserve_bos: true` to model_config.yaml or update tokenizer.json to move `` to `special_tokens` with `lstrip=false`. either should fix without changing user templates.
maria: thanks — i'll try preserve_bos now and open a small PR to update the model config in the weights bucket. will also add a unit test to catch sentinel truncation.
jeff: can you tag it `eng-ml` and link the PR here when ready? also add a short checklist item in onboarding: validate token counts for 3 canonical prompts (empty assistant, short dialog, long system msg).
maria: will do. creating PR in a few mins, pinging for review. :thumbsup: 
devon: note for runtime: please ensure serving runtime accepts models with `preserve_bos` flag and doesn't auto-normalize out sentinel chars at load time. we had regressions before.
sam: adding an automated validation step to onboarding pipeline: run token-count-diff (script) and fail if diff > 2 tokens.
maria: awesome — thanks all, PR up at https://github.com/redwood-inference/models/pull/1234 (draft) — requesting @jeff and @devon review.
jeff: ack — will review in next hour. :eyes:
